key_insight: ParetoM³ combines preference optimization with weak Pareto optimality enforcement to identify desirable trade-offs among conflicting nonconvex objectives.
engineering_relevance: It offers a first-order approach for balancing competing model objectives according to a predefined preference function.
method: Use a merit function that vanishes on the weak Pareto set.
Combine preference minimization and a Pareto penalty in a min-max-min formulation.
Apply a single-loop first-order algorithm to seek stationary solutions.
evidence_signal: Experiments on a synthetic benchmark, image classification, regression, and math reasoning report preferred weak Pareto solutions and strong practical performance.
watch_item: Theoretical guarantees require a local Kurdyka–Łojasiewicz assumption and a sufficiently large penalty parameter; they do not establish global preference optimality.
paper_title: ParetoM$^3$: Learning on the Pareto Set under Preference Guidance via Min-Max-Min Optimization
